high_level_description: The image shows a person holding a bottle of Vaseline Intensive Care Aloe Fresh lotion. The bottle is green with a white pump dispenser and a blue label that prominently displays the brand name "Vaseline" and the product name "Aloe Fresh." The label also mentions "Intensive Care" and "Non-Sticky," indicating the product's features. The volume of the lotion is 400 ml. The person holding the bottle appears to be sitting on a bed or a similar surface covered with a patterned fabric. The fabric has a mix of colors, including maroon, beige, and black with some floral designs.
